sentence: BMI is an NHS check on whether weight suits height, but it cannot tell muscle from fat, so waist size and a GP discussion add to it.
note: BMI cannot tell difference between muscle and fat; use as starting point for discussion with GP

sentence: The NHS BMI calculator checks whether a person is a healthy weight for their height.
note: NHS calculator checks if you are a healthy weight for your height

sentence: BMI cannot tell muscle from fat, so very muscular people may be rated overweight and people who lose muscle with age may still fall in the healthy range.
note: BMI cannot tell muscle from fat; athletes; older adults who lose muscle

sentence: The NHS says Black, Asian and some other minority ethnic groups have a higher risk of some long-term conditions at a lower BMI.
note: NHS notes higher risk at lower BMI in Black, Asian and some other minority ethnic groups

sentence: NHS treatment for obesity ranges from lifestyle changes and weight management programmes to medicines and surgery.
note: NHS: lifestyle changes, programmes, medicines, surgery

sentence: Body mass index, or BMI, is calculated from height and weight, and the NHS calculator uses it to check whether an adult is a healthy weight for their height.
note: NHS BMI calculator for checking if healthy weight for height

sentence: The calculator shows which category a result falls in, and the NHS gives a different healthy range for Black, Asian and some other minority ethnic groups.
note: Different healthy range for Black, Asian and some other minority ethnic groups

sentence: The reason given is that these groups have a higher risk of developing some long-term conditions, such as type 2 diabetes, at a lower BMI.
note: Higher risk of long-term conditions such as type 2 diabetes at lower BMI

sentence: BMI cannot tell the difference between muscle and fat, so it measures whether someone is carrying too much weight rather than too much fat.
note: BMI cannot tell difference between muscle and fat; measures too much weight not too much fat

sentence: Very muscular people and athletes may be rated overweight or obese despite low body fat.
note: Very muscular people and athletes may be rated overweight or obese despite low body fat

sentence: Adults who lose muscle as they get older may fall in the healthy weight range even though they may be carrying excess fat.
note: Adults who lose muscle with age may fall in healthy range while carrying excess fat

sentence: The NHS gives a method for measuring the waist: find the bottom of the ribs and the top of the hips, place a tape measure midway between them, and measure after breathing out naturally.
note: Wrap tape midway between bottom of ribs and top of hips; breathe out naturally

sentence: The NHS says a waist measurement that is large compared with height may mean increased health risks such as heart disease, type 2 diabetes and stroke.
note: NHS: waist-to-height ratio of 0.5 or higher may mean increased risk of heart disease, type 2 diabetes and stroke

sentence: The NHS says a BMI result can be a starting point for a discussion with a GP about weight and general health.
note: BMI result as a starting point for further discussion with a GP

sentence: A GP may also check blood pressure, blood glucose and cholesterol levels, and waist circumference.
note: GP may check blood pressure, glucose and cholesterol and waist circumference

sentence: The NHS says it can be hard to lose weight, and that some people need extra support or treatment to lose weight and keep it off.
note: It can be hard to lose weight and you may need extra support or treatment

sentence: Options include lifestyle changes, weight management programmes, medicines and surgery.
note: Lifestyle changes, programmes, medicines, surgery

sentence: NHS England describes specialist weight management services as multidisciplinary, with doctors, dietitians, specialist nurses and psychologists.
note: Tier 3 services typically include a physician, dietitian, specialist nurse and clinical psychologist

sentence: Some medicines used for weight loss, including semaglutide and tirzepatide, can only be prescribed through a specialist weight management service.
note: Semaglutide and tirzepatide only prescribed by specialist weight management service

sentence: Obesity is linked to type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular disease, musculoskeletal disorders, infertility and psychiatric disorders, according to clinical sources.
note: Obesity is linked to type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular disease, musculoskeletal disorders, infertility and psychiatric disorders

sentence: The NHS describes overweight and obesity as having more body fat than the body needs.
note: Overweight and obesity are when you have more body fat than your body needs

sentence: It can happen when a person eats or drinks more than the body needs or does not do enough physical activity.
note: Can happen when you eat or drink more than your body needs or do not do enough physical activity

sentence: Other factors listed include genes, some medicines such as certain steroids, antidepressants and beta blockers, and conditions such as an underactive thyroid.
note: Genes, some medicines such as certain steroids, antidepressants and beta blockers, underactive thyroid

sentence: A GP can arrange checks such as a blood test for type 2 diabetes and tests for cholesterol and blood pressure.
note: A GP can arrange checks, such as blood test for type 2 diabetes and tests for cholesterol and blood pressure

sentence: The NHS offers a free 12-week weight loss plan as an app and a downloadable guide.
note: Free NHS 12-week weight loss plan available as an app and downloadable guide

sentence: The NHS says that for someone living with obesity, losing about 3 per cent of starting body weight can reduce the risk of obesity-related complications.
note: Losing just 3% of original body weight can significantly reduce risk of obesity-related complications
